business: Nota (@NotaGetBot): a Telegram bot that collects receipts, invoices and handwritten delivery notes from work chats into the owner's Google Sheet and flags duplicates and arithmetic errors
by_segment: Remote investor in villas or a build, living abroad
Villa management company or villa rental operator
why_not: I'd let the staff try the free part, but a café makes 30 receipts in a few days, so the free part is over before we know if it works. Then I'm paying $35 a month on top of the admin I already pay, and I think we slide back to the spreadsheet like always.

My bookkeeper and I already run everything through our expense app and it works well enough. I might let the bot read one group for the free 30 out of curiosity, but I'm not paying to move a whole year of site receipts into a new tool.

The price is nothing for a villa business, but I'm not putting some new bot I've never heard of into my staff groups and my Google account this month. I'd maybe throw a few receipts at the free version and wait to see if it's still around in a few months.

I'm not putting some bot I've never heard of into my work group and hooking it up to my Google account just to sort receipts for scooter parts and fuel. Half my money goes out in cash to mechanics anyway, so my notebook and the group chat do the job well enough.

I might throw the free 30 at it some night, but I expect it to misread the faded and handwritten nota my staff send from the warung and the hardware shop. If I still have to check every line myself, I'm not paying for it.

I'd throw the free 30 nota at it just to see, but my guys' handwritten nota from the material shop are faded, smudged and half in shorthand, and I'm pretty sure it will misread the totals. If I have to check every line anyway, I'd rather wire up my own n8n plus ChatGPT flow for a few dollars and fix it my way.

I'd let it try the free 30, but with receipts landing in three or four groups every day that's gone in a few days, and then I'm at $35 or even $79 a month just to sort receipts. That's another subscription I'd question every month, so I'd stop at the free part.

I'd run the free 30 receipts to see how it works, but $19 a month every month is a lot for a small rental shop when I could put together something like this in n8n with ChatGPT over a weekend. Writing to my own sheet is nice, but it doesn't do anything I can't do myself.

I might run the 30 free documents just to see the sheet, but I pay the contractors myself by transfer and already have the screenshots in the group. If someone double-bills me, that is my foreman's problem to answer for, not something I pay $19 a month to have flagged.
why_yes: I've already caught someone claiming the same nota twice, and my Excel sheet doesn't flag that, so I'm checking every receipt myself. It's free to try and $35 a month is nothing next to one inflated cement order, so I'd run the free 30 with a duplicate I plant myself, and if it catches it I'll pay.

I'm abroad and my admin's spreadsheet is always a week behind, so I end up scrolling the group chat at midnight trying to work out what was spent on the build. If the free 30 show it can read our notas and flag duplicates, $35 a month costs nothing next to a single double-paid invoice, so I'd pay.

The receipts are already sitting in our Telegram groups, so 30 free documents with no card costs me nothing to try before month end. If the sheet is clean when my accountant asks, $19 is nothing next to the hours I lose chasing staff for nota.
